Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
 every 2000 equivalent operating hours EOH as indicated in the title block
HP Sight glass of flame monitor, see the flame inside the combustion chamber

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets, shoes, gloves .. etc
Turbine must be shut down
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid ( WD 40 )
Rags
Work to be Carried Out
Dismantle the flame monitor ( loosing 4 bolts 19 )
Inspect the HP sight glass
Clean the HP sight glass if it is dirty
Change the HP sight glass if it is broken
Change all gasket up and down the HP sight glass
Install the flame monitor ( tightening 4 bolts 19 )
